mission: Watch the first SNKRDUNK automatic discovery runs after #180 (owner 2026-10-19 11:15Z, read-only): add one reviewed db-diagnostic, snkrdunk-discovery-guard, that recomputes the inputs of the auto-v1 planner's request_budget guard (spare window budget, pending RAW checks due within 40 minutes, highest RAW check request cost in 24 h), lists snkrdunk-due executions from their stored execution evidence, and the RAW check cost distribution, because the planner logs its skip reason only to stdout. Register it in ops-readonly. Staging only; PSA10 not read; no collector, setting, budget, price, identity, mapping, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change.

impacts.reason: Four SELECT/WITH-only statements over app_log_events (snkrdunk-collector raw_execution_started/finished rows), source_dispatch_budgets, freshness_work, freshness_attempts and sources, run only in the existing default_transaction_read_only db-diagnostic session with its statement timeout. No write, no source request.
Adds snkrdunk-discovery-guard to the diagnostic choice list (the test keeps it equal to scripts/diagnostics). No permission, secret, environment or trigger change.

resources.name: GitHub Actions: ops-readonly db-diagnostic (one new read-only SQL file)

dependencies: ops runbooks from PR #139, #143, #150, #155, #157, #158; diagnostics from PR #156, #166, #174, #177 and #178 (unchanged); auto-v1 planner from PR #180 (unchanged)
impact.deployment_impact: One read-only diagnostic and its workflow choice entry. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. No path under services/, packages/ or apps/ changes; snkrdunk and yuyutei collectors untouched.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR removes the diagnostic and its workflow choice. No data, schema, provider or service configuration to undo.
recovery.trigger: A db-diagnostic run of the new file that fails the read-only check, exceeds its statement timeout, or returns anything but query rows.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: After merge: one ops-readonly db-diagnostic snkrdunk-discovery-guard run completes with status ok, and its ops-summary carries rows or names them in rows_omitted.
